jobPostingInfo.title: Software Engineer, Agent Runtime
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Are you ready to turn agent research into dependable, production-grade systems? Join us!

At Cyberdyne, we build the runtime that keeps autonomous agents sandboxed & observable.

What You’ll be Doing:

  • Track the cutting edge: follow research on tool use and planning, and bring what works into the product.

  • Design isolation for untrusted code.

What We Need to See:

  • 5+ years writing systems software in Rust or Go.
